correctness.rationale: For n>=2 iid continuous uniform U[a,b], condition on the sample extreme endpoints: interior observations are iid uniform between them as unordered symmetric statistics, hence S^2 scales as R^2 times the variance of 0,1 and n-2 independent U[0,1] values. Evaluating E sum Z_i^2=1+(n-2)/3 and E(sum Z_i)^2=(n-2)/12+n^2/4 gives c_n=(n+1)(n+2)/(12n(n-1)) in E[S^2|R]=c_n R^2. With R/(b-a)~Beta(n-1,2) exact moments yield unbiasedness, Var(c_nR^2), Cov(R,S^2) and Corr(R,S^2)^2. The standard fourth central moment formula gives Var(S^2)=(b-a)^4(2n+3)/(360n(n-1)); the relative variance is 10(2n^2+6n+1)/[(n+3)(n+4)(2n+3)], equals one at n=2 and <1 for all n>=3, with asymptotic 10/n. Independently reconstructed all rational calculations for n=2..150, rather than trusting CHECKER_OUTPUT.txt. The conditional endpoint derivation establishes all n, and no UMVU or other-distribution claim is made.
